description_zh: 创建并注册一个数据集加速槽
kebab_example: aliyun paielasticdatasetaccelerator create-slot --instance-id inst-my1tk3jggooi5uwks5 --name slot_1 --description XGBoost_dataset_acceleration_slot --tags Value=v0.1.0 Key=dataset_version --storage-type OSS --storage-uri oss://pai-vision-data-hz2.oss-cn-hangzhou-internal.aliyuncs.com/data/VOCdevkit/VOC2007/ImageSets/Main/val.txt --capacity 30.0G --life-cycle example-string --io-type readonly --endpoints Type=VPC VpcId=vpc-j6co2fcdsl1q0gnuc3ym3 VswitchId=vsw-j6cmr00qjyrft6jo2mg7g Name=endpoint-1 --endpoint-ids end-my1tk3jggooi5uwks5,end-n69468yvjz8d12as7d,end-tga4omjrepklkg1onn --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateSlot

parameters.help_en:
The maximum capacity of the slot.
The format of the input string must conform to the Quantity (https://kubernetes.io/zh-cn/docs/reference/kubernetes-api/common-definitions/quantity/) specification
parameters.help_zh:
数据集加速槽的最大容量。
输入字符串的格式需要满足以下规范：Quantity (https://kubernetes.io/zh-cn/docs/reference/kubernetes-api/common-definitions/quantity/)
parameters.name: capacity

parameters.help_en: The description of the slot. The description can be up to 1024 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 数据集加速槽的描述与解释。长度限制为1024个字符
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The list of mount point IDs to mount when creating the slot. Separate multiple mount point IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 创建数据集加速槽时，同时挂载的数据集加速槽挂载点ID的列表，多个挂载点ID以半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: endpoint_ids

fields.help_en:
The name of the mount point.
The name can be up to 64 characters in length.
If the value is empty (including an empty string), the system uses the value of the Uuid field as the default name
fields.help_zh:
挂载点的名称。
长度限制为64个字符。
如果传入值为空（包含空字符串），系统会使用Uuid字段的值作为默认名称
fields.name: name

fields.help_en:
The network type of the mount point. The required parameters vary based on the network type.
VPC: The endpoint machine is in a VPC network
fields.help_zh:
挂载点的网络类型，根据网络类型不同，下列中需要传入的参数也有所不同。
VPC：端点机器处于VPC网络
fields.name: type

fields.help_en: The VPC ID used by the mount point
fields.help_zh: 挂载点使用的专有网络 VPC ID
fields.name: vpc_id

fields.help_en:
The vSwitch ID used by the mount point.
The vSwitch must belong to the specified VPC
fields.help_zh:
挂载点使用的交换机vSwitch ID。
该vSwitch需要属于传入的VPC
fields.name: vswitch_id

parameters.help_en: The list of mount points to create along with the slot
parameters.help_zh: 创建数据集加速槽时，同时创建的挂载点列表
parameters.name: endpoints

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the Dataset Accelerator instance associated with the slot. For information about how to obtain the instance ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/467899.html
parameters.help_zh: 数据集加速槽所对应的数据集加速实例的唯一标识符。如何获取加速实例ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/467899.html
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The read/write property of the slot. Valid values:
readonly: read-only.
readwrite: read and write
parameters.help_zh:
数据集加速槽的读写属性，取值如下：
readonly：只读
readwrite：可读写
parameters.name: io_type

fields.help_en: Configuration of the dataset acceleration slot lifecycle. The structure of the configuration varies depending on the type. For more complex configuration requirements, it can be parsed as a JSON string.
fields.help_zh: 数据集加速槽生命周期配置，根据类型不同，配置结构也不同。 如果有更加复杂的配置需求，可以解析为Json String
fields.name: config

fields.help_en:
The type of dataset acceleration slot lifecycle.

KeepAlive: Keeps running and will not be released.
RelativeTime: Released after running for a specified duration, in seconds.
AbsoluteTime: Automatically released at the specified point in time.
MaximumIdleTime: A relative time interval; if the difference between the last operation time and the current time exceeds this interval, the instance is released, in seconds.
fields.help_zh:
数据集加速槽生命周期类型。 

KeepAlive：保持运行，不会被释放 。
RelativeTime：运行一段时间后释放，单位为秒 。
AbsoluteTime：运行到该时间点时，将会自动释放 。
MaximumIdleTime：相对时间间隔，最后一次操作时间和当前时间差超过该间隔，即释放实例，单位为秒
fields.name: type

parameters.help_zh: 数据集加速槽的生命周期
parameters.name: life_cycle

parameters.help_en: The name of the slot. The name can be up to 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 数据集加速槽名称。长度限制为64个字符
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The storage type of the slot. Valid values:
OSS: OSS file storage.
NAS: NAS file storage
parameters.help_zh:
数据集加速槽的数据存储类型，取值如下：
OSS：OSS文件存储。
NAS：NAS文件存储
parameters.name: storage_type

parameters.help_en: The resource identifier of the data in the slot. The format varies based on the data type
parameters.help_zh: 数据集加速槽的数据的资源标识符，数据类型不同存在不同格式
parameters.name: storage_uri

fields.help_en: The key of the tag. The key can be up to 64 characters in length
fields.help_zh: 标签的键值。长度限制为64个字符
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The value of the tag. The value can be up to 64 characters in length
fields.help_zh: 标签的值。长度限制为 64 字符
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The custom tags added to the slot
parameters.help_zh: 用户为数据集加速槽添加的自定义标签
parameters.name: tags
